method: NJ statewide parcels + MOD-IV. Kept: vacant, commercial and industrial lots of 0.15 acre or more (buildings worth under 75% of the land) inside a designated Area in Need of Redevelopment or within half a mile of a passenger rail station, in Bergen, Hudson, Essex, Passaic, Union and Morris counties. NJ has no statewide zoning map: each row links the municipality's zoning map and ordinance from the NJ DCA directory. Redevelopment plans can set density above base zoning.
